Name: Wickedy's Theater Concessions Vending Machine
Author: WickedyWoah
Description:
[size=5][b]Hey, Hi, Howdy, and Hello 

[/b][/size]Who doesn't want theater popcorn or sour slimes and all your favorite theater treats right in your own living room?
I don't know, but I DO know that these treats are so cute, I really wanted to be able to have a way to use them outside of just at the theater concessions stand.

So, I made a handy little vending machine so you can have some for yourself too!

There are a total of 24 theater concessions, and all of them have their own loves, likes, and dislikes. So, I referenced the preferences in the game and made these obtainable as snackable and giftable treats to go along with my recent [url=https://youtu.be/WYSIeNvoR0o]Movie Theater guide[/url].

This vending machine is craftable. It and its recipe can also be bought over at the Stardrop Saloon, it takes batteries, pizza, Joja cola, iron bars, and refined quarts bars to craft. In order to get a vending treat, just input 3 gold ore and wait 30 minutes. You will receive any one of the random 24 treats. One treat, the Stardrop Sorbet is a mostly universal love, with everything else having a few different loved preferences. I have a [url=https://wickedychickady.com/movies/]"concessions loved sheet"[/url] if you'd like to see who loves what.

You will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url] for the vending machine to work.
